text:
Bruno Fernandes: “It’s tough to say something, it’s been a tough period for us, we have not been able to perform the way we want. We have not been consistent. Today was important to get a win. We knew after half time we still had the fans with us and we could change it with a goal. Fortunately we did.
“IN the first one it didn’t go the way I wanted, I did something wrong with the way I prepared. I cleared my head and scored.
“It’s been tough for the fans but having their belief helps the side. Today was one of those days that Old Trafford came alive and we made Roma experience that.
“It is about performing and getting results at this club. It’s been a long time without a win, it’s been frustrating for them and us too. The fans want to win games, they are used to seeing this club at the top. We are frustrated with the situation at the moment and hopefully this win is the start of something good.
“We don’t need to save anyone’s job. The club and the players needed that win. The situation has been tough, there have been a lot of lies in the media. The manager made a decision to put me on the bench because of my performances, that’s fair. People thought it was a punishment for the words I said and if it was, he was right, the manager is the one who makes the decision and I have to agree with that.”
Youri Tielemans: “It is brilliant. The fans were brilliant. Tonight the turnaround was brilliant. We were on the front foot in the second half and we succeeded. There has been a lot of pressure on the manager and we paid him back with a comeback. All we can do is stick behind him and support him.
“At the end of the say we are on the pitch, we need to show what we are capable of.
“Let’s hope this is a good turnaround for us and we can build on this.”
How on earth did that happen? It looked like a completely different United team after the break. The first 45 minutes was complete and utter mediocrity but they were resurgent, re-energise and fought back. They were fortunate with the retaken penalty and the equalise but heard hard work earned that, before Cunha’s stunning winner.
90+1 mins: United are still pressing and putting in the effort but Cunha is overzealous and crashes into a defender. He is given a second booking; his first came for celebrating the third goal.
GOAL! A stunning pass from Lacey finds Cunha inside the box, he takes a touch and then hits the ball with the ferocity of a very angry man to beat the goalkeeper at the near post. The Brazilian then dives into the crowd and everyone is loving it.
84 mins: I think it is far to say this has been a game of two halves. Roma were dominant in the first, United in the second. Will we get a dramatic end?
77 mins: United look a threat from set-pieces, so maybe should try and work a way of winning more corners.
In the meantime, Cunha forces the goalkeeper into a decent save with a shot from distance. Lacey picks up the loose ball and defeats Wesley, getting a cross in, only to be taken down by the wing-back. United want a penalty but the officials are having none of it.
75 mins: Martinez and Lacey are coming on. The Argentinian gets a mixed reception as he replaces Heaven, while the academy graduate is cheered as Diallo goes off.
Roma take off Mancini and Hermoso, Ndicka and Ghilardi on.
68 mins: Another corner! Mbeumo lifts it to the back post where Maguire is battling to get on the end of it, having got the better of Balerdi, but he can’t get his effort on target.
67 mins: Mbeumo swings in a second corner from the right, which is headed back across goal for Dalot to nod towards the net, only to it cleared off the line.
66 mins: United have a corner on the left for Fernandes to whip in. It reaches Maguire at the back post but his header is blocked by Wesley.
One key issue for United is a lack of options on the bench. Carrick could bring on Lacey, Mount or Zirkzee if he wants an attacking option but it’s not the most exciting thought.
65 mins: United are moving at greater speed, going from one end of the pitch to the other. It catches Roma out and gives Dalot a chance but he hits the side netting.
United go back at Roma and Fernandes finds Diallo in the box, he cuts in but his shot is blocked. United are on top here.
63 mins: Obviously, we should also remember the wider Champions League context because a loss here would mean it is three defeats in four for United in the competition.
59 mins: Cunha sends the ball through for Mbeumo who reaches it first and takes aim. His shot defeats the goalkeeper but comes back after hitting both posts. Old Trafford is rocking now.
digest_he: המשחק בין מנצ'סטר יונייטד לרומא במסגרת ליגת האלופות סיפק דרמה ענקית, כאשר המארחת הפכה פיגור מוקדם של שני שערים לניצחון 2-3 בסיומו של משחק הפכפך. המחצית הראשונה הייתה בסימן שליטה של רומא, אך האדומים מהשიטרו הציגו יכולת משופרת פלאים לאחר ההפסקה. שער מצמק בפנדל חוזר של ברונו פרננדש נתן האות למומנטום חדש, ומאטוס קוניה הפך את התוצאה עם צמד מרשים שהבטיח את הניצחון היקר למארחת. למרות ההרחקה של קוניה בתוספת הזמן לאחר צהוב שני, יונייטד הצליחה לשמור על היתרון עד הסיום ולקחת את מלוא הנקודות.
